content: Service Name Can Tr cv_ Get Op Mode Syntax Std_ Return Type Can Trcv_ Get Op Mode ( uint8 Transceiver, Can Trcv_ Trcv Mode Type* Op Mode ) Service ID [hex] 0x02 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Transceiver CAN transceiver to which API call has to be applied. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) Op Mode Pointer to operation mode of the bus the API is applied to. Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: will be returned if the operation mode was detected. E_ NOT_ OK: will be returned if the operation mode was not detected. Description Gets the mode of the Transceiver and returns it in Op Mode. Available via Can Trcv.h
